```{r nodes voor parallelle berekening}

Nds <- 2

```


```{r ophalen gegevens}

Fint.data <- 
  read_delim(str_c("../../../Data/Data_processed/data_dwarspunten_UA_", Alternatief.scenario, ".csv"), delim = ";")

Fint.data.1D <- 
  read_delim(str_c("../../../Data/Data_processed/data_dwarspunten_UA_", Alternatief.scenario, "_1D.csv"), delim = ";")

```


```{r berekenen geschiktheidsscore larvaal, eval=TRUE}

cat("\n berekening larvaal \n")

Data.larvaal <- 
  Fint.data %>% 
  select(afstand_vlissingen, Omes, jaar, X, Y, 
         temp_linear, oxygen_linear, salinity_linear, spm_depth_avg_linear, zoo_C_linear, depth, max_vel) %>% 
  drop_na()

names(Data.larvaal) <- 
  c("afst","OMES","jaar","x","y",tolerance_larval$var)

Vars <-
  tolerance_larval %>% 
  filter(!(var %in% c("temp"))) %>% # alle variabelen behalve temp
  pull(var)


cat("   berekening op alle variabelen \n")

#### berekenen op alle variabelen ####

new_set_larval <- 
  select_variables(tolerance_larval, rules_larval, Vars)

Data.larvaal$SI <- 
  Data.larvaal %>% 
  calculate_SI_par(new_set_larval$new_tolerance, new_set_larval$new_rules, nodes = Nds)


cat("   berekening per variabele \n")

#### berekenen per variabele ####
for(vr in Vars) {
  cat("     var = ", vr, "\n")
  new_set <- 
    select_variables(tolerance_larval, rules_larval, vr)
  Data.larvaal[str_c("SI_", vr)] <-
    Data.larvaal %>% 
    calculate_SI_par(new_set$new_tolerance, new_set$new_rules, nodes = Nds)
}
```

```{r berekenen geschiktheidsscore paai}

cat("\n berekening paai \n")

Data.adult <- 
  Fint.data.1D %>% 
  select(afstand_vlissingen, Omes, jaar, X, Y, 
         temp_A_linear, oxygen_A_linear, salinity_A_linear, depth, avg_vel) %>% 
  drop_na()
names(Data.adult) <- 
  c("afst","OMES","jaar","x","y",tolerance_adult$var)


Vars <-
  tolerance_adult %>% 
  filter(!(var %in% c("temp", "SI_l"))) %>% # alle variabelen behalve temp en SI_l 
  pull(var)


cat("   berekening op alle variabelen \n")

#### berekenen op alle variabelen ####
new_set_adult <- 
  select_variables(tolerance_adult, rules_adult, Vars)

Data.adult$SI <- 
  Data.adult %>% 
  calculate_SI_par(new_set_adult$new_tolerance, new_set_adult$new_rules, nodes = Nds)


cat("   berekening per variabele \n")

#### berekenen per variabele ####
for(vr in Vars) {
  cat("     var = ", vr, "\n")
  new_set <- 
    select_variables(tolerance_adult, rules_adult, vr)
  Data.adult[str_c("SI_", vr)] <-
    Data.adult %>% 
    calculate_SI_par(new_set$new_tolerance, new_set$new_rules, nodes = Nds)
}


cat("   wegschrijven resultaten \n")

#### afronden ####
Data.adult <-
  Data.adult %>% 
  mutate(across(starts_with("SI"), ~round(., 3)))


#### wegschrijven ####
Data.adult %>% 
  write_delim(str_c("../../../Output/resultaten_fint_", Alternatief.scenario,"_adult_1D.csv"),
              delim = ";")

```
